_read_me: Where publish.py puts each built file in Supabase Storage. Placeholders available in a path: {sop_id} {file} {stem} {version} (version is underscored, e.g. 1_4).
_paths_source: html and pdf match the object paths the portal reads: src/data/sops.json's html and pdf fields, written by tools/build-sops-index.py as html/<id>.html and pdf/<id>_v#_#.pdf, then read by src/pages/team/sops/sop-viewer-screen.tsx (storage.download) and sops-content.tsx (createSignedUrl). md and json are left out on purpose: the sops bucket only accepts text/html and application/pdf (supabase/migrations/20260920100000_sops_bucket.sql).
_not_confirmed_because: The paths are right, but uploading here does not make anything live on its own. The SOP list is src/data/sops.json, bundled into the site, so a new version only shows after that file is regenerated, committed and deployed. WEB-003, 004 and 005 are read from public/sops/ in the repo, never from this bucket (isPublicSop in sops-content.tsx). after_publish cannot fix either, because it runs in the Action and anything it writes is thrown away.
